parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time to query bills of burstable clean bandwidth that are generated before the specified time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: EntityObject
parameters.description:
The IP address of the Anti-DDoS instance to query.

> You can call [DescribeInstanceDetails](~~91490~~) to query the IP addresses of Anti-DDoS instances.

parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description:
The type of system logs to query. The value is fixed at **20**, which indicates the billing logs of burstable clean bandwidth.

> You must set this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the returned page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of logs to return on each page.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time to query bills of burstable clean bandwidth that are generated after the specified time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds.
